fields.System.Title: FDN-604 — Set tracking flags
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want to mark a product as batch-tracked, expiry-tracked, or
serial-tracked, so that receiving, allocation, picking, and counting apply the right rules.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a product, then requires_batch, requires_expiry, and requires_serial can
  • each be set.
  • - Given requires_expiry is set, then requires_batch must also be set.
  • - Given a temperature class or hazmat class, then it restricts which locations are legal
  • for the product.
  • - Given a flag is set at creation, then it cannot be changed once stock exists — see
  • [FDN-607](FDN-607-freeze-fields.md).
  • - Given a flag change, then an event is published so dependent modules react.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata |
| Tables | product |
| Risks | Wrong temperature or hazmat class causes spoilage and safety incidents ([doc 03 §7.6](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
